    Documentation

    The HEPkit Python reference

    From a model
    to a calculation.

    Explore the tools for generating diagrams, working with tensors, and reducing amplitudes and integrals. The reference brings 117 pages together in one place.

    01 / Models & amplitudes

    HEPkit

    Particle models, Feynman diagrams, amplitudes, kinematics, and tensor reduction.

     02 / Tensors & networks

    Tensor algebra

    Abstract indices, tensor expressions, contractions, and numerical evaluation.

     03 / Loop calculations

    One-loop integrals

    Symbolic reduction to scalar master integrals and native numerical evaluation.

     04 / Integral families

    Integration by parts

    Exact parametric and Laporta reductions with native HEPkit builds.

     05 / Vacuum calculations

    Vacuum integrals

    Analytic and numerical evaluation of single-scale vacuum integrals with Vakint.

     06 / Run a calculation

    Live examples

    Open a notebook, edit the code, and run a particle-physics calculation in your browser.

    Useful starting points

    Begin with a Model and a Process to generate diagrams. Work with their symbolic structure using TensorExpression, or explore Amplitude and IntegralFamily for subsequent calculations.

    For installation and the underlying computer algebra API, see Symbolica’s getting-started guide and Python reference.
